question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Infinite
solution:
The correct answer is: **Evanescent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Infinite **means limitless or endless. (असीमित या अंतहीन)
 
• **Evanescent **means fleeting or temporary. (क्षणभंगुर या अस्थायी)
 
• The antonym of a word is a word that has the opposite meaning.
 
• Therefore, the antonym of infinite is evanescent.
